title: Muddy Heart
tagline: Muddy Heart is an On-chain action RPG game powered by @lattizexyz's MUD engine.
description: Muddy Heart is an action RPG game that operates entirely on the blockchain, utilizing the powerful MUD engine developed by @latticexyz. The game takes place in a fighting arena and supports up to six players. Muddy Heart is designed to be easily adaptable and expandable, allowing developers to explore, customize, and enhance the project to their liking.
how_its_made: The game process of this project is powered by @latticexyz's MUD engine, working behind the scenes to handle the computations. For the frontend development, we utilized ReactJS to create an engaging user interface. In addition to utilizing @latticexyz's MUD engine for the game computations, we also incorporated the solecs library to facilitate the connection between the frontend and the MUD engine.
